title: GET /reservations — scoped list with status/asset/requester filters and pagination
objective: Verify the new list endpoint (Rev 1.2) returns reservations scoped to the caller's visibility, supports filters (status, asset, requester) and the D-09 pagination envelope.
preconditions: Reservations existing across two departments and statuses (requested/confirmed/checked_out/returned/cancelled); operator dept-A, operator dept-B, admin sessions.
steps: List as admin with each filter; verify membership.
List as operator dept-A; verify only dept-A-scoped (or own/custody) reservations returned.
Verify envelope {count,next,previous,results} and page traversal without duplicates.
expected_result: Server-side filtering correct; scope predicate identical to asset visibility rules (cross-scope records never serialized); pagination consistent; invalid filter values → 400, never 500.

title: Overdue identification — overdue=true filter returns exactly the overdue set
objective: Verify overdue=true returns precisely reservations whose end_at has passed while still active (confirmed/checked_out per documented rule), with correct overdue duration, completing FR-010.
preconditions: Fixtures: R1 confirmed ending yesterday (overdue), R2 checked_out ending last week (overdue per rule), R3 confirmed ending tomorrow (not overdue), R4 returned last week (closed, not overdue).
steps: Query overdue=true; compare returned set to fixtures R1/R2 only.
Verify response exposes end_at/status sufficient to compute overdue duration (or a provided overdue_days field).
Verify overdue items are also surfaced where documented (dashboard KPI linkage if wired).
expected_result: Returned set == {R1, R2} exactly; closed/future reservations excluded; rule for which active statuses count as overdue is documented and consistent between list filter and any dashboard badge.

title: /reservations page — list, filters, overdue highlighting (icon+text), responsive
objective: UI: the new /reservations page lists scoped reservations with status badges, filter bar incl. overdue toggle, and renders correctly at desktop and mobile widths; overdue items visually flagged not-by-color-alone.
preconditions: Full stack; Playwright; operator signed in; seeded overdue + current reservations.
steps: Open /reservations at 1440px; verify table/cards, badges, filter application, empty state on no-match filter.
Toggle overdue filter; verify only overdue rows and their flag (icon+text).
Repeat at 375px; verify no horizontal scroll and usable actions.
expected_result: Page matches API truth; overdue flag per layout §5.3 (not color alone); URL query params sync filters; nav item present per §6 sidebar update. (Browser-unavailable → BLOCKED.)

title: Regression — reservation lifecycle rules unchanged by list addition
objective: Re-verify core C2 guarantees after the C3 list/page work: overlap → 409 RESERVATION_CONFLICT (contract clarification 11), checkout creates single assignment, double-checkout conflict, idempotent reserve replay.
preconditions: Reservable asset; operator session; C2 backend suite green as baseline.
test_data: overlapping reserve payloads; checkout twice; Idempotency-Key replay on reserve
steps: Replay reserve with same Idempotency-Key → same response, one reservation.
Confirm full backend pytest suite still green.
expected_result: All C2 behaviors intact; new endpoint introduces no authorization or integrity regressions.
